content:
Key
Value
desc
The group's description.
group_id
The group's ID.
mobile_otp_enabled
Legacy parameter; no effect if specified and always
returns false . Use Duo Authentication Method
policies to configure this setting.
name
The group's name. If managed by directory sync, then
the name returned here also indicates the source
directory.
push_enabled
Legacy parameter; no effect if specified and always
returns false . Use Duo Authentication Method
policies to configure this setting.
sms_enabled
Legacy parameter; no effect if specified and always
returns false . Use Duo Authentication Method
policies to configure this setting.
status
The group's authentication status. May be one of:
Status
Description
"Active"
The users in the group must complete
secondary authentication.
"Bypass"
The users in the group will bypass
secondary authentication after
completing primary authentication.
"Disabled"
The users in the group will not be able
to authenticate.
voice_enabled
Legacy parameter; no effect if specified and always
returns false . Use Duo Authentication Method
policies to configure this setting.
